attributes.name: Druva - Multiple Recovery Jobs Started
attributes.description: Detects a burst of restore or recovery jobs initiated during a short detection window.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a burst of restore or recovery jobs initiated during a short detection window.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
  or druva.event_type:*Recover*
  or druva.event_type:*Restore*
)
and (
  message:*started*
  or message:*initiated*
  or event.outcome:"Started"
)
